name: News Reporter
exampleLine: What they discovered next changed everything.

name: Velvet Static
exampleLine: Some people disappear. Not because they stopped caring. But because caring became too loud.

name: TikTok Male
exampleLine: The truth about why they left was never what they told you.

name: TikTok Female
exampleLine: She knew. She always knew. She just wasn't ready to say it out loud.

name: Deep Storyteller
exampleLine: There are things that happen in the dark that daylight never gets to explain.

name: Midnight Confession
exampleLine: I never told anyone this. But the night everything changed, I wasn't even surprised.

name: Reddit Noir
exampleLine: AITA for cutting off my entire family after what I found in the basement.

name: The Shadow
exampleLine: Power doesn't corrupt people. It reveals who they always were.

name: Deep Story
exampleLine: There is a version of you that exists only in someone else's memory. You'll never know what they remember.

name: Documentary
exampleLine: In 2019, a single decision unraveled a decade of carefully constructed lies.

name: Professor
exampleLine: The psychology of avoidance is not weakness. It is the oldest form of self-preservation we have.

name: Calm Narrator
exampleLine: So this actually happened. And I still don't fully understand it.

name: Horror Ghost
exampleLine: She kept leaving notes. We didn't realize until later — she had been dead for three days.

name: Analog Horror
exampleLine: If you are watching this recording — do not go back to sleep.

name: Paranormal
exampleLine: The investigators noted something unusual about the footage. At 3:17 AM, the clock stopped. All of them.

name: Creepy Calm
exampleLine: He smiled. That was the part nobody mentioned in the police report. He was smiling the whole time.

name: Fast Viral
exampleLine: This is the ONE thing every successful person does before 6am — and nobody talks about it.

name: Gym Motivator
exampleLine: Every champion was once a contender who refused to give up. That choice is yours. Right now.

name: Hype Man
exampleLine: Wait — you actually haven't heard about this? Let me change your entire perspective in 30 seconds.

name: Confident Authority
exampleLine: The people who succeed aren't smarter. They're just more comfortable being uncomfortable.

name: Emotional Confession
exampleLine: I kept telling myself I was fine. And then someone asked if I was okay — and I just completely fell apart.

name: Heartbreak
exampleLine: The hardest part wasn't missing them. It was waking up and forgetting for exactly three seconds that they were gone.

name: Late Night Thoughts
exampleLine: It's 3am and I'm still trying to understand how someone who loved you could just stop.

name: Natural Narrator
exampleLine: Look — I know this is going to sound weird. But hear me out.

name: Podcast Host
exampleLine: Welcome back. Today we're going into something I've wanted to talk about for a while.

name: Gen-Z Voice
exampleLine: Okay no wait — this is actually kind of insane. You need to hear this.

name: ASMR Whisper
exampleLine: You've been carrying this for so long. And it's okay to just... let it rest for a moment.

name: Chill Commentary
exampleLine: So I found out something today that I genuinely cannot stop thinking about. Sit down.

name: Luxury Brand
exampleLine: The ones who truly have everything never need to announce it.

name: British Elegance
exampleLine: Civilizations are not built by the loudest voices. They are shaped in silence, by those who choose not to explain themselves.

name: Noir Detective
exampleLine: In this city, everyone's hiding something. The difference between criminals and civilians is just who got caught.

name: Conspiracy Voice
description: Urgent • Suspicious • You Need to Hear This
exampleLine: They removed this video three times. Here's what they don't want you to understand.

name: The Mysterious One
exampleLine: What if the reason you can't let go has nothing to do with love — and everything to do with fear of what you'll find in the silence.

name: Comedy Robot
exampleLine: I have calculated that your ex has made seventeen questionable decisions since leaving you.

name: Cave Oracle
exampleLine: What you seek lies deeper than these stones.

name: Dungeon Wizard
exampleLine: Few have read what you are about to hear.

name: Cosmic Monk
exampleLine: And so the universe answered, in a language older than language.

name: Dark Story Narrator
exampleLine: Some endings begin in silence — long before the words arrive.

name: Ancient Librarian
exampleLine: This passage was meant to be forgotten — and yet, here it is.

name: Shadow Prophet
exampleLine: There is a name written under your name. You have not read it yet.

name: Mythic Guardian
exampleLine: What you are about to hear has crossed a thousand years to find you.

name: Ethereal Spirit
exampleLine: I do not arrive in the wind. I arrive in the pause between breaths.

name: Gravel King
exampleLine: I have buried men for less. Listen carefully.

name: Forbidden Text Narrator
description: Solemn • Grave • Reads as if pages might burn
exampleLine: These were not meant to be spoken. We will whisper them anyway.

name: Raspy Oracle Narrator
description: Slightly raspy • Cinematic YouTube storyteller • Powerful but warm
exampleLine: What you are about to hear has been waiting a long time to find you.

name: TikTok Male — Natural
exampleLine: Most people miss this — but the ones who get it never forget.

name: TikTok Male — Cinematic
exampleLine: And just like that, everything you thought you knew quietly changed.

name: TikTok Male — Raspy
exampleLine: Some truths only land when the voice telling them has a few miles on it.

name: TikTok Male — YouTube Narrator
exampleLine: Here is the part most channels never tell you.

name: TikTok Female — Natural
exampleLine: You felt it before you understood it — that's the part nobody talks about.

name: TikTok Female — Cinematic
exampleLine: There was a version of this story you weren't supposed to hear.

name: TikTok Female — YouTube Narrator
exampleLine: And this is where most people stop paying attention — but they shouldn't.

name: Ancient King
exampleLine: Hear me — for what I say has been said by men long buried.

name: Medieval Oracle
exampleLine: Three things will arrive before the moon turns again.

name: Cave Prophet
exampleLine: The walls remember. They have been listening longer than you have been alive.

name: Dungeon Storyteller
exampleLine: There were three doors. Only one of them opened from the inside.

name: Old Warlock
exampleLine: I have spoken these words to younger men. Most of them did not return.

name: Cathedral Monk
exampleLine: Breathe slowly. The answer is older than your question.

name: Gravel Knight
exampleLine: I have been to the edge. I came back with a story you should hear.

name: Shadow Bard
exampleLine: Some loves are not lost. They are merely waiting at a different gate.

name: Elder Dragon
exampleLine: I have watched empires rise. They all forgot the same thing.

name: Forbidden Librarian
exampleLine: This page should not exist. And yet, here we are reading it.

name: Royal Seer
exampleLine: What awaits you was already prepared. You only need to walk toward it.

name: Night Watchman
exampleLine: Stay sharp. The thing you are most certain of is the thing that betrays you first.

name: Stone Temple Priest
exampleLine: Patience is not waiting. Patience is the discipline of staying ready.

name: Wandering Sage
exampleLine: I have walked this road before. It changes — but never as much as you do.

name: Dark Cosmos Narrator
exampleLine: Across the dark, something has been turning toward you for a long time now.

name: Ancient Flamekeeper
exampleLine: Carry the spark. Most who tried to put it out are dust now — and still cold.

name: Quiet Giant
exampleLine: I will not raise my voice. I have never needed to.

name: Mythic Guardian II
exampleLine: What you protect about yourself is the very thing the world needs from you.

name: Raspy Oracle II
exampleLine: What you sense — but cannot name — is the most accurate part of you.

name: Old Kingdom Narrator
exampleLine: What follows was recorded the year the rivers ran low — when truth was easier to see.
